blocked_customers_identity_ck.name: blocked_customers_identity_ck
blocked_customers_identity_ck.value: "blocked_customers"."customer_id" IS NOT NULL OR "blocked_customers"."email_normalized" IS NOT NULL

conversation_messages_author_ck.name: conversation_messages_author_ck
conversation_messages_author_ck.value:
("conversation_messages"."author_type" = 'team' AND "conversation_messages"."author_user_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("conversation_messages"."author_type" = 'customer' AND "conversation_messages"."author_customer_id" IS NOT NULL)
        -- Compared as text: a migration cannot reference a value it adds to
        -- the enum in the same transaction.
        OR ("conversation_messages"."author_type"::text = 'juno' AND "conversation_messages"."author_user_id" IS NULL)
        OR "conversation_messages"."author_type" = 'system'

conversations_csat_rated_ck.name: conversations_csat_rated_ck
conversations_csat_rated_ck.value: "conversations"."csat_rating" IS NULL OR ("conversations"."csat_requested_at" IS NOT NULL AND "conversations"."csat_rated_at" IS NOT NULL)

juno_feedback_actions_title_ck.name: juno_feedback_actions_title_ck
juno_feedback_actions_title_ck.value: "juno_feedback_actions"."title" IS NULL OR length("juno_feedback_actions"."title") between 3 and 140

knowledge_sources_url_ck.name: knowledge_sources_url_ck
knowledge_sources_url_ck.value: ("knowledge_sources"."kind" = 'url' AND "knowledge_sources"."url" IS NOT NULL) OR ("knowledge_sources"."kind" = 'upload' AND "knowledge_sources"."url" IS NULL)

away_reply_body.name: away_reply_body
away_reply_body.default: 'Thanks for your message. Our team is away right now and will reply as soon as we are back.'
